names: memoryaccess registers (o_ce 305; writeback is combinational, the RF write lands at the edge)

token.meaning: memoryaccess o_pc on the cycle-boundary state (= memoryaccess_pc 76 on the driven state, Ob_obs)

valid.meaning: memoryaccess o_ce (305) = 1 on the boundary state (= writeback_ce 90 on the driven state)

pending_view.note: RF lanes j = ISA x(j+1) of the model (all committed); pending writes of the alu/memoryaccess tokens only through Tok and fwdv

front.cursor: A5RrDefs.Front (F1..F5: fetch token / prev_pc / o_iaddr, ack-guarded instruction register)

operating.step_shape: commit: exists y index', run1 f = (Some tt, y) /\ token = pc f /\ Op (cycle s) y index'; silent: Op (cycle s) f index /\ rank decreases

observer.via: A5RrDefs.obs_b (boundary-state token); target observer by Ob_obs + sched_agree in A5RrFinal

rank.meaning: cycles to the next commit: 0 (305), 1 (237), 2 (171), 3 (143), 4 (ce & ack), 5 (ce), 6 (reset only)
